skills.name: Hazardous Solution
skills.description: Throws a potion.  10% chance to poison for 6 seconds.  5% chance to slow for 8 seconds.  5% chance to reduce damage for 8 seconds.  5% chance to reduce defense for 8 seconds.  5% chance to reduce attack speed for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Chaotic Elixirs
skills.description: Throws a total of 2 harmful potions and 2 beneficial potions. Harmful potions have:  10% chance to poison for 6 seconds.  5% chance to slow for 8 seconds.  5% chance to reduce damage for 8 seconds.  5% chance to reduce defense for 8 seconds.  5% chance to reduce attack speed for 8 seconds. Beneficial potions have:  15% chance to apply continuous healing for 8 seconds.  10% chance to increase defense for 8 seconds.  10% chance to increase damage for 8 seconds.  10% chance to increase attack speed for 8 seconds.  10% chance to increase speed for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Soul Orb
skills.description: Launches an energy ball that hits 1 enemy, growing bigger and dealing more damage the further it travels.  35% chance to reduce defense for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Soul Weakening
skills.description: Steals 25% of the target's remaining HP (10% for Bosses and Elite monsters).  66% chance to reduce attack for 6 seconds.  66% chance to prevent healing for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Judgment
skills.description:
Summons a devastating orbital beam on the target, dealing repeated damage.
Targets with less than 30% HP take 50% additional damage.
Reduces the skill’s cooldown by 3 seconds for each enemy killed with it.

skills.name: Soul Stealer
skills.description: Gains Resurrection for 16 seconds when Anubis defeats an enemy.  Increases his size by 2.5%, and his attack and max HP by 2.5% per enemy defeated, up to a maximum of 20 times.

skills.name: Astral Orbs
skills.description: Launch 2 series of 2 orbs towards the enemy.  Each having a 10% chance of removing a beneficial effect from the target.

skills.name: Black Hole Vortex
skills.description: Charges and launches a black hole, pulling enemies to its center before exploding and dealing damage to all targets.  +85% critical hit chance.  40% chance to prevent healing for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Life Pulsar
skills.description: Each critical hit releases a healing wave, healing nearby allies for 3% of its Max HP.

skills.name: Charge
skills.description: Charges in the direction of the target.  15% chance to stun.

skills.name: Frustration
skills.description: Becomes angry and increases its attack and speed for 12 seconds.

skills.name: Bullet Seed
skills.description: Shoots 2 seed bullets.

skills.name: Poison Bomb
skills.description: Throws a poison bomb that can hit 1 enemy.  Poison the target for 6 seconds and blind the target for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Malachite spear
skills.description: Gives a spear thrust that pierces up to 2 enemies.  50% chance to prevent healing for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Mushroom Shield
skills.description: Generates a shield for 7 seconds that neutralizes enemy projectiles and restores 5% of max HP for each projectile destroyed.

skills.name: Spear Jab
skills.description: Strikes with a spear, piercing through up to 2 enemies.

skills.name: Toxic Powder
skills.description: Coats his weapon with a toxic powder that is active for 15 seconds, poisoning targets hit for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Titan Strike
skills.description: Hits up to 2 targets.  Ignores 15% of the target's Defense.

skills.name: Boulder Throw
skills.description: Throws a boulder at 1 target.  80% chance to reduce defense for 8 seconds. The rock splits into 4 fragments that each deal half the damage of the boulder.  Each fragment has a 25% chance to reduce defense for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Ultra Laser
skills.description: Fire a laser from the eye of the cyclops, damaging 12 times to the first target in path.  Each hit has a 25% chance to cancel the target's passive for 12 seconds.

skills.name: Titanic Resilience
skills.description: Immune to poison and defense reduction effects.

skills.name: Fierce Charge
skills.description: Charges toward the target, dealing damage to an enemy.  Reduces the energy of hit targets by 5.  50% chance to reduce defense for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Confusing Waves
skills.description: Fires 4 waves toward the target, hitting all enemies in their path.  70% chance to prevent the usage of abilities for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Pyro-Whip
skills.description: Strikes with its flaming tail to hit 2 enemies.  If the target is burning, guarantees a critical hit and extends harmful effects on the target by 2 seconds.

skills.name: Flamethrower
skills.description: Creates a fiery breath that hits all enemies in its path 5 times.  40% chance to burn for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Meteoric Pyrolysis
skills.description: Flies into the air and crashes down, dealing heavy damage to all enemies in the area and burning them for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Final Conflagration
skills.description: Causes defeated burning enemies to explode.

skills.name: Precise Shot
skills.description: Shoots an iron arrow with +10% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Dmg.

skills.name: Frost Arrow
skills.description: Increases its attack for 12 seconds, then shoots a frost arrow at 1 enemy.  Stuns the target for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Vampiric Sundering
skills.description: Strikes the target and restores HP equivalent to 35% of the damage dealt if the target is affected by a defense reduction.  50% chance to reduce defense for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Frozen Spikes
skills.description: Enchants its weapon to summon a series of 5 ice spikes ignoring 30% of the target's defense.  80% chance to slow for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Heavy Brambles
skills.description: Strikes an enemy twice.  Each hit has a 25% chance to immobilize the target for 4 seconds.  If the target is already immobilized, each hit has a 35% chance to stun them for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Thorn Prison
skills.description: Summons thorns from the ground that immobilize enemies caught in them for 6 seconds, deal damage, and reduce their energy by 20 points.  Then the thorns retract, pulling enemies closer along their path.

skills.name: Fertilizer
skills.description: Defeated allies in a 5m radius cause a flower to bloom.  This flower restores 20 energy, and grants nearby allies continuous regeneration for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Cross Strike
skills.description:
Attacks twice.
The first attack has a 25% chance to reduce the target’s Defense for 6 seconds.
The second attack pierces up to 2 enemies and has a 50% chance to inflict bleed for 6 seconds if the target is affected by a defense reduction.

skills.name: Weak Spot
skills.description:
Vanishes in a smoke screen, blinding nearby enemies for 12 seconds, then reappears behind the enemy with the lowest HP to deliver a powerful strike that ignores damage-preventing effects.
If the target is affected by Bleed, the attack is guaranteed to critically hit and ignores 25% of the target’s defense.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Launches a fireball toward the enemy, dealing damage to all enemies upon explosion.  50% chance to burn for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Fire Deluge
skills.description: Summons a series of 5 fireballs.  80% chance to burn for 5 seconds.  Prevents healing for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Stone Arrow
skills.description: Shoots 1 arrow with +15% CRI Dmg.

skills.name: Triple Shot
skills.description: Shoots 3 bone arrows piercing through 1 target.

skills.name: Dynamite Toss
skills.description: Throws 2 sticks of dynamite that explode on impact.  Guaranteed elemental advantage.

skills.name: Barrel Trap
skills.description: Fires an explosive barrel that lands on the ground. Enemies ignore it, but any hit sets it off.  Guaranteed elemental advantage.

skills.name: Club Swing
skills.description: Hit an enemy with a club.  25% chance to reduce defense for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Magic Berry
skills.description: Eats a magic berry. Recover 30% of Max HP and removes all harmful effects.

skills.name: Hammer Swing
skills.description: Hammers 1 enemy.  35% chance of stunning the target.

skills.name: Aerial Stomp
skills.description: Jump into the air to land on all enemies in the area.  75% chance to slow for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Battle Totem
skills.description: Place a totem on the ground that raises the attack of allies.

skills.name: Goblin Frenzy
skills.description:
Each time he takes damage, the Goblin Chieftain gains +2% attack and +2% defense, stacking up to 30 times.
The effect stops if he doesn’t take any more damage for 15 seconds.

skills.name: Rock Punch
skills.description: Throws a punch.  35% chance to reduce attack for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Iron Defense
skills.description: Raise its defense and gains immunity to harmful effects for 12 seconds.

skills.name: Spectral Claws
skills.description: Delivers a melee claw strike, stealing 25% of the damage dealt with +25% Crit Dmg, and fires a ghostly projectile that has a 30% chance to reduce the target's attack speed for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Cursed Skull
skills.description: Launches a giant skull in a straight line, piercing through all enemies.  Prevents the application of beneficial effects for 10 seconds and removes one beneficial effect from affected targets.

skills.name: Ice Crystals
skills.description:
Fires 3 ice crystals toward the target.
Ignores 15% of the target’s defense.

skills.name: Ice Wall
skills.description: Summons a wall of ice that is hurled at enemies, knocking them back and reducing their attack speed for 8 seconds.  The ice wall has 70% of its Max HP.

skills.name: Absolute Zero
skills.description: Immune to burn effects.  When the immunity is activated, releases a wave that removes one debuff from allies in the area.  Heals itself for 5% of Max HP per debuff removed.

skills.name: Ivy Arrow
skills.description: Fires an arrow that pierces enemies affected by at least 2 harmful effects.  Damage increases by 20% for each enemy pierced.  Has a 25% chance to inflict Bleed on hit enemies.

skills.name: Ivy Rain
skills.description: Summons a rain of arrows dealing damage to all enemies in the area every 0.2 seconds for 4 seconds.  Each hit has a 25% chance to reduce enemies' Defense for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Camouflage
skills.description: Becomes invisible for 6 seconds the first time it drops below 50% of its Max HP.

skills.name: Evil Trident
skills.description: Throws its trident, piercing through up to 2 enemies.  25% chance to reduce defense for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Burning Grounds
skills.description: Creates a zone that damages enemies every second.  Steals 5 energy from enemies and has a 30% chance to prevent healing for 8 seconds with each hit.

skills.name: Killjoy
skills.description: 20% chance to steal a beneficial effect from the enemy, replaced by a bleeding for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Lunar Chakrams
skills.description: Throw 2 chakrams in arc.

skills.name: Lunar Barrage
skills.description: Lunadrya dodges by jumping back while throwing 2 chakrams simultaneously.  Increases her speed for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Celestial Guardian
skills.description: Lunadrya summons a lunar bear to fight alongside her.

skills.name: Sturdy Bond
skills.description: Gains +25% damage reduction while the lunar bear is alive.

skills.name: Beastly Claw
skills.description: Hit and knock back 2 enemies.  25% chance to reduce defense for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Celestial Roar
skills.description: Roars with the power of the moon and creates 2 zones, reducing the attack of targets in the area with a 50% chance for 8 seconds and increasing the defense of allies for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Powerful Bond
skills.description: Gains +15% CRI Rate and +35% CRI Dmg while Lunadrya is alive.

skills.name: Embalmed Whip
skills.description: Whips its arms, hitting a target.  25% chance to reduce attack speed for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Cursed Embrace
skills.description: Awakens the mummy's curse to extend its arms and attack a target, slowing it for 10 seconds.  If the target is already slowed, it is immobilized for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Vermin Crusher
skills.description: Slams its mace into the ground, dealing damage to an enemy.  70% chance to reduce their Defense for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Peckish
skills.description: Pulls out its favorite ham from its pocket, restoring 15% of its Max HP and increasing its Attack for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Ravenous Bite
skills.description: Bites an enemy, dealing heavy damage and restoring 35% of the damage dealt as HP.  If the enemy is defeated, steals all their buffs and restores 100 Energy.

skills.name: Glutton
skills.description: Increases healing received by 30% based on missing Max HP.  Defeating an enemy resets the cooldown of Ravenous Bite.

skills.name: Magic Bubble
skills.description: Shoots a bubble at an enemy.  35% chance to remove a beneficial effect.  If the target has no beneficial effect, 35% chance to inflict Minimize for 8 seconds instead.

skills.name: Tidal Waves
skills.description: Summons a series of 4 waves.  The waves heal allies and increase their movement speed for 8 seconds.  Enemies are pushed back, and each hit has a 35% chance to remove a beneficial effect.

skills.name: Jellyfish Rebirth
skills.description: Grants Revive for 4 seconds to the nearby ally with the lowest HP% every 10 seconds.

skills.name: Magic Ball
skills.description: Throws a ball of energy at the target.  20% chance to reduce attack for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Healing Staff
skills.description: Heals the ally with the lowest HP for an amount equal to 100% of Attack and applies continuous healing for 5 seconds as well as immunity to harmful effects for 7 seconds.

skills.name: Acid Bullet
skills.description: Spit a corrosive projectile.  15% chance to reduce attack speed for 6 seconds.  30% chance to remove a beneficial effect from the target.

skills.name: Caustic Bullet
skills.description: Spit an extra corrosive projectile.  Burns the target for 10 seconds.  50% chance to reduce defense for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Deep Cut
skills.description: Deals damage to a maximum of 2 targets.  Each harmful effect on the target raises damage by 15%.  50% chance to reduce defense for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Swirling Blade
skills.description: Whirls with its blade towards the target hitting 7 times all enemies within range, bringing them closer.  Each hit has 50% chance to cause the target to bleed for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Executioner
skills.description: Increases critical chance by 15% and damage by 30% relative to the target's missing HP.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: Attacks with shield.  40% chance to reduce attack for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Scarab Charge
skills.description: Increases defense for 5 seconds, then dashes toward enemies.

skills.name: Scarab's Blessing
skills.description: Calls upon the blessing of the divine scarab to gain immunity to debuffs for 12 seconds. Then, unleashes a laser that deals heavy damage and blinds enemies for 10 seconds.  Allies gain critical hit resistance for 12 seconds.  Ignores knockback while using this skill.

skills.name: Golden Shell
skills.description: Gains +25% damage reduction when not affected by harmful effects.  Receiving a beneficial effect reduces the cooldown of Scarab's Blessing by 4 seconds.

skills.name: Frost Scourge
skills.description: Strikes one enemy.  25% chance to freeze the target for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Runic Cry
skills.description: Increases critical rate for 7 seconds.

skills.name: Glacial Upheaval
skills.description: Strikes a nearby enemy with a sword, freezing him for 5 seconds.  Then summons a series of 6 permafrost spikes, each dealing increasing damage.  Each hit has a 35% chance to freeze the target for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Frozen Body
skills.description: Damage taken per hit cannot exceed 15% of max HP.  Whenever this cap is triggered, regenerates 5% of max HP.

skills.name: Cut
skills.description: Deals damage to a target with +30% accuracy.  15% chance to prevent healing for 7 seconds.

skills.name: Sharp Triplet
skills.description: Attack 3 times.  Each hit has a 30% chance to prevent healing for 7 seconds.

skills.name: Sticky Jump
skills.description: Jumps on the target.  25% chance to slow for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Sticky Slap
skills.description: Hits 1 target with a slap that knocks him back.  Steals all beneficial effects from the target.

skills.name: Leech Bite
skills.description: Jumps and crunches the target and steals 20% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Ice Shard
skills.description: Shoots an ice shard towards the target, piercing up to 2 enemies.  30% chance to decrease defense for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Musical Burst
skills.description: Launches a series of 5 musical notes.  10% chance to increase attack speed for 4 seconds when a target is hit.

skills.name: Motivational Anthem
skills.description: Heals 30% of his max HP and applies Bulk Up to an ally (except himself) for 12 seconds.

skills.name: Empowering Concert
skills.description: Unleashes his musical fervor, increasing the attack and critical rate of all allies within range for 4 seconds, extending the duration of beneficial effects by 4 seconds, and removing one harmful effect from each ally.

skills.name: Musical Tempo
skills.description: Gains +20% cooldown reduction while HP is above 80% of Max HP.

skills.name: Furious Shell
skills.description: Spins its shell toward the target, dealing damage to all enemies in its path, then returns to its original position.  Reduces knockback by 100% during the charge.

skills.name: Bone Shell
skills.description: Sharpens its shell to reflect 30% of the damage taken and prevent HP from dropping below 1 for 16 seconds.

skills.name: Knock out punches
skills.description: Hit twice.  The first hit has a 30% chance to reduce defense for 6 seconds.  The second hit knocks back the target and has a 15% chance to stun for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Flaming Kicks
skills.description: Jump 2 times towards the target.  Each hit has 50% chance to burn the target for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Air Strike
skills.description: Call in an airstrike that drops bombs along its path, leaving fire fields that burn enemies for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.description: Becomes enraged and increases its attack speed by up to +25% and its knockback resistance by up to +50% as his health decreases.

skills.name: Bat Attack
skills.description: Launch 2 bats in a straight line.

skills.name: Shadow Punch
skills.description: Charges up to 2 enemies in a straight line and deals damage while ignoring 25% of the target's defense.

skills.name: Bat Storm
skills.description: Creates a storm of bats and deals damage 7 times to all enemies in the area.  Each hit reduces attack speed and speed for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Blood Thirsty
skills.description: Gains 25% of lifesteal when below 70% of Max HP.

skills.name: Razor-Sharp Claws
skills.description: Jumps to the target and delivers a 2-hit combo, then leaps back to safety.  30% chance to prevent healing on the first hit for 6 seconds.  50% chance to prevent healing on the second hit for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Predator's Howl
skills.description: Howls at the moon, applying Bulk Up for 8 seconds and healing for 20% of missing HP.

skills.name: Predator Slam
skills.description: Leaps ferociously towards the marked target, grabbing and stunning it for 4 seconds.  Slams the target into the ground, dealing damage equal to 20% of its max HP and damaging nearby enemies.

skills.name: Predator's Mark
skills.description: Marks an enemy (bosses excluded), reducing its attack speed and movement speed by 10%.  Additionally, damaging the marked enemy grants 10% of the damage dealt as HP.

skills.name: Voracious Leap
skills.description: Leaps towards the target and steals 20% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Undead Madness
skills.description: Screams in rage and increases his speed and attack speed for 10 seconds.
